definitions.full: H3877. Lotan לוֺטָן proper name, masculine ᵐ5 Λωταν ; a son of שֵׂעִיר Gen 36:20 , 22 = 1Chr 1:38-39 , and father of חֹרִי etc. Gen 36:22 = 1Chr 1:39 ; called a chief ( אַלוּף ) of הַחֹרִי Gen 36:29 .
